generator: OpenAI built-in image generation plus deterministic raster post-processing
style: Rich top-down Chinese scholar-table scene, carved dark wood, pale jade, parchment, cinnabar and antique gold

masters.strategy: One coherent 4x4 transparent atlas generated in a single pass so small UI assets share lighting, material, perspective and palette.
Shared wood-and-jade source used for the board surface and matching UI treatments.
New integrated portrait scene generated as a single image for the game background and lobby cover, with bamboo, incense, scroll, inkstone, brush and chess pieces already composed in one perspective.

processing.atlasSplit: Fixed 4x4 cells, alpha-island cleanup, crop, contain and deterministic PNG export.
processing.pieceTypography: Character-aware calligraphy is baked into independent PNG sprites; both player and enemy rooks use 車. Runtime pieces and reinforcement previews never compose glyph labels over a base image.
